description: Audit one local or immutable remote model artifact and return local static evidence. Request section=model_summary for the common operation/storage table derived from Model IR; it does not infer framework trainability or runtime order. Supported remote identities are hf:// with a full commit, gs:// with an object generation, and HTTPS with SHA-256. Remote bytes may be downloaded into a content-addressed local cache but are never uploaded by DEEPBOM. Findings distinguish artifact_defect, caution, and evidence_gap; an evidence_gap is not a defect. The result never establishes executed accelerator assignment, latency, energy, accuracy, or device fit.

activation_baseline.description: Reference activation capture JSON under allowed roots; requires activation_evidence for the same Model IR. Compare distributions and run identity in numerical_details. No model execution or task-quality inference.

activation_evidence.description: Local hash-bound activation capture JSON under allowed roots. Imports execution evidence; does not execute a model. Use output_format=json and section=activation_ir.

cache_dir.description: Content-addressed cache directory under the allowed roots.

evidence_files.description: Local directory under allowed roots containing files explicitly mapped by metadata. No remote links are fetched. Requires metadata.

expected_sha256.description: Independent expected digest for a local or remote artifact.

external_data_dir.description: Local ONNX external_data or ExecuTorch .ptd sidecar directory under the allowed roots.

gate.description: Return a policy-blocked status when an artifact_defect is present. Nothing is gated by default.

list_sections.description: List selectable analysis sections instead of auditing.

max_download_gib.description: Upper bound for one remote download in GiB.

metadata.description: Local deepbom.provenance_input.v1 or deepbom.omop_metadata_input.v1 JSON under allowed roots. Adds Provenance IR; select provenance_ir. Declarations are not execution attestation.

metadata_template.description: Return a metadata template bound to this model; fill institution/release identity before importing. Mutually exclusive with metadata.

offline.description: Refuse network access and require a verified cache receipt.

output_format.description: summary is the bounded human-readable default. Request envelope for the canonical cross-format contract, json/json-compact for format-specific evidence, CycloneDX 1.7, or SARIF explicitly.

path.description: Local artifact/package path under DEEPBOM_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS, or an immutable hf://, gs://, or hash-pinned HTTPS source.

pointer.description: Emit one RFC 6901 JSON Pointer result, such as /operator_count.

policy.description: Built-in gate profile. Engineering blocks artifact defects; regulatory also requires evidence gaps to be resolved but does not determine legal compliance.

scan.description: Bounded scan policy. structure avoids payload integrity work; integrity streams supported payload checks; full requests all supported static analysis.

section.description: Emit only these analysis sections, comma-separated. Use list_sections first. model_summary returns deepbom.model_summary.v1. Applies to json formats.

target.description: TFLite target profile id for cost-model binding; it is not host detection.

tensor_limit.description: Maximum tensor rows to return; requires tensors=true. The result includes next_offset when more rows exist.

tensor_offset.description: Zero-based tensor row offset for a bounded tensor page; requires tensors=true.

tensors.description: For a GGUF artifact, return the bounded structure-only deepbom.tensor_table.v1 projection instead of the full tensor/numerical ledgers.

tf_metagraph.description: Select the serialized SavedModel MetaGraph index; default 0. No TensorFlow code is executed.

weight_analysis.description: Opt in to common Weight IR and advanced channels, cosine similarity, SVD, sparsity and quantization. JSON sections: weight_ir, weight_analysis, weight_comparison. No model execution.

weight_baseline.description: Optional local original artifact for exact aligned weight comparison.

weight_mapping.description: Local JSON array of baseline/candidate weight references and optional candidate_axis_permutation; requires weight_baseline.

weight_options.description: Local JSON file with explicit tensor axes and computation budgets.

name: deepbom_audit
title: Audit a deployed model artifact
